name: Lesson 4: Dealing with charts, tables, forms and double, triple passages
descriptionHtml:
Questions involving charts, tables and forms, and questions involving double and triple passages require a slightly different approach. Here we will concentrate on dealing with these question types.

1. Question type

In this section, you will be asked to answer questions related to charts, tables or forms. You also must deal with questions involving double and triple passages. 

 

2. Guide to answer

- With questions involving charts, tables and forms:

+ You need to understand parts of charts, tables and forms. This will help you quickly identify the parts of the passage/ chart/ table where the information you need can be found.

+ Skim the questions and passage to find information quickly. This will help you identify which part of the text is referred to. Then compare the answer choices to that part of the chart, table of form.

Note: Be careful of the "small print": Charts, tables and forms may include notes or extra information at the bottom. Check this before choosing an answer to avoid making unnecessary mistakes.

- With questions involving double and triple passages, watch for connected information among texts. In each double and triple passage, there will be at least one question that will require you to look at two or three texts and connect the information. It is important to read two or three passages before answering questions.
